create_DirectionalLights: create a DirectionalLights instance with ambient, diffuse, and specular color tensors on a device
create_PointLights: create a PointLights instance with ambient, diffuse, and specular color tensors at a given location
test_DirectionalLights_diffuse: test the DirectionalLights diffuse method by computing diffuse lighting from normals and light direction
test_PointLights_specular: test the PointLights specular method by computing specular highlights from points, normals, and camera position
